title: FBI Photo A003
what_is_it: A single still image (photo) submitted to AARO as a UAP report, with an accompanying government narrative description of the image.
interpretation_warnings: No extractable source text — all facts derive from war.gov CSV metadata and the supplied narrative description only.
Government narrative explicitly states the description is informational and not an analytical judgment, investigative conclusion, or factual determination.
No date or location was provided, so the event cannot be placed in time or space.
Imagery was redacted before submission, so the public version is incomplete.
Single-source report with no mission report; the operator could not identify the object.
A dark object centred on a crosshair may reflect sensor framing, not the object's true significance.
